scope: Resolve the separate transformer-only and live shift-period workload conventions before research measurements. Neither replaces fixed-normal H3 evidence or the frozen offline H2 evaluation. This supplement does not change fitted models, cutoffs, hypothesis rules, original results or source-access stages.
ordering_clarification: The fixed and transformer-only concurrent clients reuse the manifest's planned dispatch/output order. Actual TCP admission order may differ and is recorded by admission_sequence; neither stateless workload claims identical arrival/scoring order across repeats. The stateful live shift workload below is strictly serialized instead. Offline future-only window indices cannot be applied to reordered concurrent arrivals as evidence of causal HTTP routing.

fixed_cascade.specification: Unchanged http-replay-v1, including 0.1%/1%/5% references, the complete concurrency sweep and designated physical-invocation reference. Runtime keeps drift normal; no monitor scoring is included.

transformer_only.input: The identical private 10,000-row 1% reference manifest used by fixed-cascade H3, with original raw URLs; never resample or fetch URLs.
transformer_only.runtime: Use the same fixed hardware, singleton numerical method, owner-thread service, HTTP schemas, queue, client, total deadline and phase fences as fixed cascade. Workload is selected at service startup, never from a request or outcome. Each repeat starts a fresh service/scorer/client.
transformer_only.included_work: Character normalization/tokenization, singleton device transfer, actual transformer forward, float32 sigmoid, carried-forward transformer threshold, JSON response and the complete client-measured HTTP path.
transformer_only.excluded_work: No structural feature extraction, Logistic-L1 evaluation, length-only score, GMM NLL or monitor window update. score_all is not this workload because it also executes stage one. Loading authenticates the shared accepted bundle but does not add stage-one inference to request timing.
transformer_only.accounting: Every successful measured request has exactly one physical transformer attempt and one successful score, independently checked against drained counters. Failed or unadmitted requests remain visible; do not assume every attempted HTTP request reached the forward.
transformer_only.interpretation: Worst-case escalation comparator means stage two runs for every admitted URL, not an absolute bound over URL lengths, hosts, future model sizes or arrival rates. This is the 1% manifest comparator, not an additional all-prevalence study.

shift_period.input: The immutable full retained external manifest in published-file order, produced during the separately frozen external preparation/scoring sequence. Every retained role participates; no source/label filtering, resampling, perturbation or raw-source rescan.
shift_period.measured_requests_per_run: N, the full frozen retained stream size; report N explicitly rather than substituting the H3 10,000/50,000 denominators
shift_period.warmup: Replay the first 1000 retained rows. If fewer exist, report insufficient warmup capacity without selecting a different source. Drain and fence warmup, then explicitly clear only monitor window/activation state on the same owner before measured position 1. Keep physical counters monotonic and difference them across phases; do not carry warmup alerts into measurement.
shift_period.serialization: Exactly one measured request may be unresolved at the scorer. On client timeout, fence/drain that occurrence before submitting the next row. Verify every planned identity was admitted once and has completed; a missing, late, reordered or failed-scoring row stops the workload as incomplete, rather than shifting window indices or skipping it. No retries or concurrent-dispatch approximation.
shift_period.included_work: Live structural stage-one score, inclusive-band/prior-alert routing, at most one actual transformer forward, frozen portable monitor feature, singleton GMM NLL, each complete float64 256-value window at stride 64, strict boundary comparison, future activation update and HTTP response. No cached NLLs or routing masks substitute for timed monitor work.
shift_period.causality: At measured position t, route using only already completed prior windows. Compute/update the window ending at t after scoring that row and before admitting t+1. The first 256 measured rows use the fixed cascade. An alert ending at t selects only t+1 through t+256, with overlapping activations unioned and end-of-stream truncation. Strict serialization avoids treating already-arrived concurrent requests as future arrivals.
shift_period.cross_check: Reconcile complete successful live traces against the independently saved offline full-stream replay at identical thresholds. A mismatch is execution-integrity evidence, not permission to change either trace, parameters or original scientific results.
shift_period.interpretation: This is serialized live-policy operational characterization conditional on the fixed stream. It is not a concurrency-64 scalability result, a causal intervention, a new H2 support test, or primary H3 evidence. Report all repeats or incomplete attempts without replacement.

common_reporting.identity: Bind workload, run index, manifest payload hash, exact code revision, binding-contract hash, accepted model hashes and observed runtime/hardware. Caller-supplied labels on an arbitrary service are not provenance; the official runner must construct and authenticate the matching service and client together.
common_reporting.time: Retain every client terminal latency. Record the measured client-phase wall interval from worker launch through all terminal outcomes, separately from the final drain interval. Controls, warmup and model loading are excluded from client-phase latency/throughput.
common_reporting.throughput: Report measured attempted requests divided by client-phase wall seconds and successful responses divided by that same interval. These are closed-loop client rates, not unconstrained offered-load capacity. Also report drain duration and physical completed/failed/forward counts so timeouts cannot hide queued work.
common_reporting.distribution: Report pooled individual p50/p95/p99, error count/rate and physical invocation fraction per workload/concurrency/prevalence; retain run-level summaries and raw private outcomes. Apply H3 gates only to the original fixed-cascade cells.
common_reporting.failures: Do not retry or replace adverse runs. Transport/request failures remain measured outcomes; failed drain, shutdown, authentication, stream-integrity or finalization makes the execution incomplete. An immutable reservation and unsuccessful producer status remain part of the record.

remaining_before_research_execution: Implement and independently test the serialized live-monitor service, per-timeout acknowledgement and warmup monitor reset; no current HTTP mode accepts shift_period
Complete authenticated one-pass internal and staged external source adapters, realized private manifest binding and process-isolated official execution runner

Resolve every declared secondary analysis, including MMD/PSI, calibration metrics, McNemar/Holm families, perturbation/shortcut/permutation probes, seeds 42-46 and Random Forest, before protected outcomes. This supplement neither drops those commitments nor authorizes additional fitting under the singleton amendment

Verify exclusive benchmark sessions and power/thermal/competing-work conditions; no concurrent training or model benchmarks on the measurement machine. Synthetic timing is for scheduling only, not research performance
